assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of unspecified atrial fibrillation
The palpitations have not been adequately characterized by standard short-term monitoring
A 30-day continuous ambulatory ECG monitoring study is indicated
The appeal requests reconsideration of the CO-22 denial
The medical necessity for the long-term continuous ECG monitoring is well documented in the clinical indication note
The CPT code for long-term continuous ECG monitoring is 93247
